company.shortDescription: Maven offers live courses with real-world experts in AI, product, marketing, design, engineering & more.
company.description: Maven is an online platform for cohort-based courses, enabling experts to create and teach engaging, live online classes on AI, product, engineering, design & more. Founded by Gagan Biyani (Udemy co-founder), Wes Kao (co-founder of altMBA), and Shreyans Bhansali (co-founder of Socratic), Maven empowers instructors with tools to build, market, and scale high-quality learning experiences.
